title: Retry temporary errors in the read-only API client
body: In the client's GET request method, retry HTTP 429 and 503 responses up to three times after the initial request. Respect Retry-After in seconds when present; otherwise wait one second between attempts. Do not retry other statuses or network exceptions. Return the first successful response, or return the final response unchanged when retries are exhausted. Add tests for success after retry, exhausted retries, Retry-After, and non-retryable responses. Do not change the public method signature.
